styles.name: Minimalism & Swiss Style
styles.zh: 极简主义 / 瑞士风格
styles.tag: 企业后台 · 文档站 · 专业工具
styles.description: 以网格、留白和字号层级建立秩序，只用黑白灰加一个强调色。信息密度可控、装饰为零，适合需要长期阅读与高频操作的专业界面。
styles.primary: Monochromatic, Black #000000, White #FFFFFF
styles.secondary: Neutral (Beige #F5F1E8, Grey #808080, Taupe #B38B6D), Primary accent
styles.bestFor: Enterprise apps, dashboards, documentation sites, SaaS platforms, professional tools
styles.avoid: Creative portfolios, entertainment, playful brands, artistic experiments
styles.prompt: Design a minimalist landing page. Use: white space, geometric layouts, sans-serif fonts, high contrast, grid-based structure, essential elements only. Avoid shadows and gradients. Focus on clarity and functionality.
styles.checklist: ☐ Grid-based layout 12-16 columns, ☐ Typography hierarchy clear, ☐ No unnecessary decorations, ☐ text contrast measured against the chosen project target, ☐ Mobile responsive grid

styles.name: Neumorphism
styles.tag: 智能家居 · 控制面板 · 概念原型
styles.description: 控件从同色底板中「挤」出来：左上受光、右下投影，按下则反过来凹陷。柔和无描边，适合小面积的开关、旋钮与播放控制，不适合大面积正文。
styles.primary: Light pastels: Soft Blue #C8E0F4, Soft Pink #F5E0E8, Soft Grey #E8E8E8
styles.secondary: Tints/shades (±30%), gradient subtlety, color harmony
styles.bestFor: Health/wellness apps, meditation platforms, fitness trackers, minimal interaction UIs
styles.avoid: Complex apps, critical accessibility, data-heavy dashboards, high-contrast required
styles.prompt: Create a neumorphic UI with soft 3D effects. Use light pastels, rounded corners (12-16px), subtle soft shadows (multiple layers), no hard lines, monochromatic color scheme with light/dark variations. Embossed/debossed effect on interactive elements.
styles.checklist: ☐ Rounded corners 12-16px consistent, ☐ Multiple shadow layers (2-3), ☐ Pastel color verified, ☐ Monochromatic palette checked, ☐ Press animation smooth 150ms

styles.name: Glassmorphism
styles.tag: SaaS 后台 · 音乐/媒体应用 · 仪表盘浮层
styles.description: 半透明面板叠加背景模糊，用 1px 亮边勾出玻璃厚度。层次感强、氛围轻盈，但文字对比度依赖背景，正文密集处需谨慎。
styles.primary: Translucent white: rgba(255,255,255,0.1-0.3)
styles.secondary: Vibrant: Electric Blue #0080FF, Neon Purple #8B00FF, Vivid Pink #FF1493, Teal #20B2AA
styles.bestFor: Modern SaaS, financial dashboards, high-end corporate, lifestyle apps, modal overlays, navigation
styles.avoid: Low-contrast backgrounds, critical accessibility, performance-limited, dark text on dark
styles.prompt: Design a glassmorphic interface with frosted glass effect. Use backdrop blur (10-20px), translucent overlays (rgba 10-30% opacity), vibrant background colors, subtle borders, light source reflection, layered depth. Perfect for modern overlays and cards.
styles.checklist: ☐ Backdrop-filter blur 10-20px, ☐ Translucent white 15-30% opacity, ☐ Subtle border 1px light, ☐ Vibrant background verified, ☐ Text contrast 4.5:1 checked

styles.name: Brutalism
styles.tag: 艺术项目 · 独立品牌 · 实验性页面
styles.description: 裸露的结构、纯色块、粗黑描边与巨大字号，拒绝一切修饰。冲击力优先于精致度，适合表达态度，不适合需要信任感的企业界面。
styles.primary: Primary: Red #FF0000, Blue #0000FF, Yellow #FFFF00, Black #000000, White #FFFFFF
styles.secondary: Limited: Neon Green #00FF00, Hot Pink #FF00FF, minimal secondary
styles.bestFor: Design portfolios, artistic projects, counter-culture brands, editorial/media sites, tech blogs
styles.avoid: Corporate environments, conservative industries, critical accessibility, customer-facing professional
styles.prompt: Create a brutalist design with raw, unpolished, stark aesthetic. Use pure primary colors (red, blue, yellow), black & white, no smooth transitions (instant), sharp corners, bold large typography, visible grid lines, default system fonts, intentional 'broken' design elements.
styles.checklist: ☐ No border-radius (0px), ☐ No transitions (instant), ☐ Bold typography (700+), ☐ Pure primary colors used, ☐ Visible grid/borders, ☐ Asymmetric layout intentional

styles.name: 3D & Hyperrealism
styles.tag: 产品发布 · 硬件展示 · 品牌官网
styles.description: 用真实光照、多层阴影与景深制造物理存在感，常配 WebGL 或高质量渲染图。视觉说服力强，但资源开销大，需要降级方案。
styles.primary: Deep Navy #001F3F, Forest Green #228B22, Burgundy #800020, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0
styles.secondary: Complex gradients (5-10 stops), realistic lighting, shadow variations (20-40% darker)
styles.bestFor: Gaming, product showcase, immersive experiences, high-end e-commerce, architectural viz, VR/AR
styles.avoid: Low-end mobile, performance-limited, critical accessibility, data tables/forms
styles.prompt: Build an immersive 3D interface using realistic textures, 3D models (Three.js/Babylon.js), complex shadows, realistic lighting, parallax scrolling (3-5 layers), physics-based motion. Include skeuomorphic elements with tactile detail.
styles.checklist: ☐ WebGL/Three.js integrated, ☐ 3D models loaded, ☐ Parallax 3-5 layers, ☐ Realistic lighting verified, ☐ Complex shadows rendered, ☐ Physics animation smooth 300-400ms

styles.name: Vibrant & Block-based
styles.tag: 创意机构 · 活动页 · 年轻向产品
styles.description: 用 4–6 种高饱和纯色切成大色块，靠面积与对比而非渐变制造节奏。区块间距大、字号大，滚动像翻阅海报。
styles.primary: Neon Green #39FF14, Electric Purple #BF00FF, Vivid Pink #FF1493, Bright Cyan #00FFFF, Sunburst #FFAA00
styles.secondary: Complementary: Orange #FF7F00, Shocking Pink #FF006E, Lime #CCFF00, triadic schemes
styles.bestFor: Startups, creative agencies, gaming, social media, youth-focused, entertainment, consumer
styles.avoid: Financial institutions, healthcare, formal business, government, conservative, elderly
styles.prompt: Design an energetic, vibrant interface with bold block layouts, geometric shapes, high color contrast, large typography (32px+), animated background patterns, duotone effects. Perfect for startups and youth-focused apps. Use 4-6 contrasting colors from complementary/triadic schemes.
styles.checklist: ☐ Block layout with 48px+ gaps, ☐ Large typography 32px+, ☐ 4-6 vibrant colors max, ☐ Animated patterns active, ☐ Scroll-snap enabled, ☐ High contrast verified (7:1+)

styles.name: Dark Mode (OLED)
styles.tag: 夜间工具 · 开发者产品 · 移动端
styles.description: 纯黑底配高亮强调色，利用 OLED 像素熄灭实现真正省电与无限对比。层次靠 #121212 级的微亮面而非阴影，白色文字需降亮避免眩光。
styles.primary: Deep Black #000000, Dark Grey #121212, Midnight Blue #0A0E27
styles.secondary: Vibrant accents: Neon Green #39FF14, Electric Blue #0080FF, Gold #FFD700, Plasma Purple #BF00FF
styles.bestFor: Night-mode apps, coding platforms, entertainment, eye-strain prevention, OLED devices, low-light
styles.avoid: Print-first content, high-brightness outdoor, color-accuracy-critical
styles.prompt: Create an OLED-optimized dark interface with deep black (#000000), dark grey (#121212), midnight blue accents. Use minimal glow effects, vibrant neon accents (green, blue, gold, purple), high contrast text. Optimize for eye comfort and OLED power saving.
styles.checklist: ☐ Deep black #000000 or #121212, ☐ Vibrant neon accents used, ☐ Text contrast 7:1+, ☐ Minimal glow effects, ☐ OLED power optimization, ☐ No white (#FFFFFF) background

styles.name: Accessible & Ethical
styles.tag: 公共服务 · 医疗教育 · 政企系统
styles.description: 以 WCAG 增强级对比度为硬约束：正文 7:1、最小字号 16px、3–4px 焦点环、44px 触控区。视觉克制，但可用性优先于风格表达。
styles.primary: Measured high-contrast pairs (4.5:1 normal-text baseline; 7:1 enhanced target), simple primary, clear secondary, high luminosity (7:1+)
styles.secondary: Symbol-based colors (not color-only), supporting patterns, inclusive combinations
styles.bestFor: Government, healthcare, education, inclusive products, large audience, legal compliance, public
styles.avoid: None - accessibility universal
styles.prompt: Design toward enhanced accessibility criteria; verify complete-page conformance. Include: high contrast (7:1+), large text (16px+), keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, focus states visible (3-4px ring), semantic HTML, ARIA labels, skip links, reduced motion support (prefers-reduced-motion), 44x44px touch targets.
styles.checklist: ☐ complete-page conformance tested against the chosen target, ☐ 7:1+ contrast checked, ☐ Keyboard navigation tested, ☐ Screen reader tested, ☐ Focus visible 3-4px, ☐ Semantic HTML used, ☐ Touch targets 44x44px

styles.name: Claymorphism
styles.tag: 儿童教育 · 消费级 App · 品牌活动
styles.description: 厚圆角、内阴影加外投影，让元素像软陶一样鼓起来；配色以粉彩为主，动效带回弹。亲和力极高，但占空间、难承载高密度信息。
styles.primary: Pastel: Soft Peach #FDBCB4, Baby Blue #ADD8E6, Mint #98FF98, Lilac #E6E6FA, light BG
styles.secondary: Soft gradients (pastel-to-pastel), light/dark variations (20-30%), gradient subtle
styles.bestFor: Educational apps, children's apps, SaaS platforms, creative tools, fun-focused, onboarding, casual games
styles.avoid: Formal corporate, professional services, data-critical, serious/medical, legal apps, finance
styles.prompt: Design a playful, toy-like interface with soft 3D, chunky elements, bubbly aesthetic, rounded edges (16-24px), thick borders (3-4px), double shadows (inner + outer), pastel colors, smooth animations. Perfect for children's apps and creative tools.
styles.checklist: ☐ Border-radius 16-24px, ☐ Thick borders 3-4px, ☐ Double shadows (inner+outer), ☐ Pastel colors used, ☐ Soft bounce animations, ☐ Playful interactions

styles.name: Aurora UI
styles.tag: AI 产品 · 品牌落地页 · 发布会
styles.description: 大尺度流动渐变色带缓慢呼吸，像极光一样在深底上晕开；常用 screen 混合与 8–12s 循环。氛围强，务必给文字留纯色衬底。
styles.primary: Complementary: Blue-Orange, Purple-Yellow, Electric Blue #0080FF, Magenta #FF1493, Cyan #00FFFF
styles.secondary: Smooth transitions (Blue→Purple→Pink→Teal), iridescent effects, blend modes (screen, multiply)
styles.bestFor: Modern SaaS, creative agencies, branding, music platforms, lifestyle, premium products, hero sections
styles.avoid: Data-heavy dashboards, critical accessibility, content-heavy where distraction issues
styles.prompt: Create a vibrant gradient interface inspired by Northern Lights with mesh gradients, smooth color blends, flowing animations. Use complementary color pairs (blue-orange, purple-yellow), flowing background gradients, subtle continuous animations (8-12s loops), iridescent effects.
styles.checklist: ☐ Mesh/flowing gradients applied, ☐ 8-12s animation loop, ☐ Complementary colors used, ☐ Smooth color transitions, ☐ Iridescent effect subtle, ☐ Text contrast verified

styles.name: Retro-Futurism
styles.tag: 游戏 · 音乐发行 · 潮流品牌
styles.description: 80 年代对未来的想象：霓虹青与品红、CRT 扫描线、轻微故障抖动。情绪浓烈，适合短时沉浸，长时间阅读会疲劳。
styles.primary: Neon Blue #0080FF, Hot Pink #FF006E, Cyan #00FFFF, Deep Black #1A1A2E, Purple #5D34D0
styles.secondary: Metallic Silver #C0C0C0, Gold #FFD700, duotone, 80s Pink #FF10F0, neon accents
styles.bestFor: Gaming, entertainment, music platforms, tech brands, artistic projects, nostalgic, cyberpunk
styles.avoid: Conservative industries, critical accessibility, professional/corporate, elderly, legal/finance
styles.prompt: Build a retro-futuristic (cyberpunk/vaporwave) interface with neon colors (blue, pink, cyan), deep black background, 80s aesthetic, CRT scanlines, glitch effects, neon glow text/borders, monospace fonts, geometric patterns. Use neon text-shadow and animated glitch effects.
styles.checklist: ☐ Neon colors used, ☐ CRT scanlines effect, ☐ Glitch animations active, ☐ Monospace font, ☐ Deep black background, ☐ Glow effects applied, ☐ 80s patterns present

styles.name: Flat Design
styles.tag: 工具应用 · 后台系统 · 跨端产品
styles.description: 去掉渐变、阴影与高光，只用纯色、几何图形和清晰的字重区分层级。渲染成本最低、跨端一致，缺点是容易显得缺乏层次。
styles.primary: Solid bright: Red, Orange, Blue, Green, limited palette (4-6 max)
styles.secondary: Complementary colors, muted secondaries, high saturation, clean accents
styles.bestFor: Web apps, mobile apps, cross-platform, startup MVPs, user-friendly, SaaS, dashboards, corporate
styles.avoid: Complex 3D, premium/luxury, artistic portfolios, immersive experiences, high-detail
styles.prompt: Create a flat, 2D interface with bold colors, no shadows/gradients, clean lines, simple geometric shapes, icon-heavy, typography-focused, minimal ornamentation. Use 4-6 solid, bright colors in a limited palette with high saturation.
styles.checklist: ☐ No shadows/gradients, ☐ 4-6 solid colors max, ☐ Clean lines consistent, ☐ Simple shapes used, ☐ Icon-heavy layout, ☐ High saturation colors, ☐ Fast loading verified

styles.name: Skeuomorphism
styles.tag: 怀旧产品 · 教育演示 · 品牌彩蛋
styles.description: 木纹、皮革、金属与多层渐变还原真实材质，控件通过高光和倒角提示可按下。识别成本低但风格年代感强，现代产品多用于局部点缀。
styles.primary: Rich realistic: wood, leather, metal colors, detailed gradients (8-12 stops), metallic effects
styles.secondary: Realistic lighting gradients, shadow variations (30-50% darker), texture overlays, material colors
styles.bestFor: Legacy apps, gaming, immersive storytelling, premium products, luxury, realistic simulations, education
styles.avoid: Modern enterprise, critical accessibility, low-performance, web (use Flat/Modern)
styles.prompt: Design a realistic, textured interface with 3D depth, real-world metaphors (leather, wood, metal), complex gradients (8-12 stops), realistic shadows, grain/texture overlays, tactile press animations. Perfect for premium/luxury products.
styles.checklist: ☐ Realistic textures applied, ☐ Complex gradients 8-12 stops, ☐ Multi-layer shadows, ☐ Texture overlays present, ☐ Tactile animations smooth, ☐ Depth effect pronounced

styles.name: Liquid Glass
styles.tag: iOS / macOS 应用 · 系统级控件
styles.description: 比毛玻璃更进一步：材质随底层内容取色，边缘出现镜面折射与流动形变，转场如液体般连贯。对平台能力依赖强，需准备不透明降级。
styles.primary: Adaptive translucent material derived from surrounding content; use color judiciously
styles.secondary: Semantic content and system tint colors; preserve legibility and hierarchy
styles.bestFor: Apple-platform navigation, controls, and system-aligned app chrome
styles.avoid: content layers, dense reading surfaces, or custom effects without accessibility fallbacks
styles.prompt: Apply Apple Liquid Glass sparingly to navigation and controls. Use dynamic translucent material, lensing, and fluid transitions while keeping content clear. Respect reduced transparency and reduced motion settings.
styles.checklist: ☐ Use for navigation and controls, ☐ Keep content on a separate layer, ☐ Apply color judiciously, ☐ Test reduced transparency, ☐ Test reduced motion, ☐ Verify text and control contrast

styles.name: Motion-Driven
styles.tag: 品牌官网 · 产品发布 · 互动叙事
styles.description: 把滚动、悬停与转场当作主要叙事手段：视差分层、入场编排、状态连续过渡。观感流畅，但要为 reduced-motion 与低端设备准备静态版本。
styles.primary: Bold colors emphasize movement, high contrast animated, dynamic gradients, accent action colors
styles.secondary: Transitional states, success (Green #22C55E), error (Red #EF4444), neutral feedback
styles.bestFor: Portfolio sites, storytelling platforms, interactive experiences, entertainment apps, creative, SaaS
styles.avoid: Data dashboards, critical accessibility, low-power devices, content-heavy, motion-sensitive
styles.prompt: Build an animation-heavy interface with scroll-triggered animations, microinteractions, parallax scrolling (3-5 layers), smooth transitions (300-400ms), entrance animations, page transitions. Use Intersection Observer for scroll effects, transform for performance, GPU acceleration.
styles.checklist: ☐ Scroll animations active, ☐ Parallax 3-5 layers, ☐ Entrance animations smooth, ☐ Page transitions fluid, ☐ GPU accelerated, ☐ Prefers-reduced-motion respected

styles.name: Micro-interactions
styles.tag: 表单流程 · 移动应用 · 高频操作工具
styles.description: 在 50–100ms 内用颜色、位移与形变回应用户：按钮回弹、输入校验、加载骨架、手势反馈。单点改动小，累积起来决定产品的手感。
styles.primary: Subtle color shifts (10-20%), feedback: Green #22C55E, Red #EF4444, Amber #F59E0B
styles.secondary: Accent feedback, neutral supporting, clear action indicators
styles.bestFor: Mobile apps, touchscreen UIs, productivity tools, user-friendly, consumer apps, interactive components
styles.avoid: Desktop-only, critical performance, accessibility-first (alternatives needed)
styles.prompt: Design with delightful micro-interactions: small 50-100ms animations, gesture-based responses, tactile feedback, loading spinners, success/error states, subtle hover effects, haptic feedback triggers for mobile. Focus on responsive, contextual interactions.
styles.checklist: ☐ Micro-animations 50-100ms, ☐ Gesture-responsive, ☐ Tactile feedback visual/haptic, ☐ Loading spinners smooth, ☐ Success/error states clear, ☐ Hover effects subtle

styles.name: Inclusive Design
styles.tag: 公共服务 · 医疗健康 · 老龄用户产品
styles.description: 不依赖单一颜色或精细动作传达信息：符号 + 文字 + 图案多重编码，提供动效开关、语音与键盘路径。是规范约束，而非视觉流派。
styles.primary: Measured contrast pairs targeting 7:1 for normal text, avoid red-green only, symbol-based indicators, high contrast primary
styles.secondary: Supporting patterns (stripes, dots, hatch), symbols, combinations, clear non-color indicators
styles.bestFor: Public services, education, healthcare, finance, government, accessible consumer, inclusive
styles.avoid: None - accessibility universal
styles.prompt: Design for universal accessibility: high contrast (7:1+), large text (16px+), keyboard-only navigation, screen reader optimization, enhanced accessibility criteria with complete-page verification, symbol-based color indicators (not color-only), haptic feedback, voice interaction support, reduced motion options.
styles.checklist: ☐ complete-page conformance tested against the chosen target, ☐ 7:1+ contrast all text, ☐ Keyboard accessible (Tab/Enter), ☐ Screen reader tested, ☐ Focus visible 3-4px, ☐ No color-only indicators, ☐ Haptic fallback

styles.name: Zero Interface
styles.tag: 智能助手 · 语音设备 · 自动化流程
styles.description: 界面退到幕后：系统基于上下文预测意图，用户用语音、手势或一句话完成任务，只在必要时露出最少的控件。设计重心从屏幕转向流程与信任。
styles.primary: Neutral backgrounds: Soft white #FAFAFA, light grey #F0F0F0, warm off-white #F5F1E8
styles.secondary: Subtle feedback: light green, light red, minimal UI elements, soft accents
styles.bestFor: Voice assistants, AI platforms, future-forward UX, smart home, contextual computing, ambient experiences
styles.avoid: Complex workflows, data-entry heavy, traditional systems, legacy support, explicit control
styles.prompt: Create a voice-first, gesture-based, AI-driven interface with minimal visible UI, progressive disclosure, voice recognition UI, gesture detection, AI predictions, smart suggestions, context-aware actions. Hide controls until needed.
styles.checklist: ☐ Voice commands responsive, ☐ Gesture detection active, ☐ AI predictions hidden/revealed, ☐ Progressive disclosure working, ☐ Minimal visible UI, ☐ Smart suggestions contextual

styles.name: Soft UI Evolution
styles.tag: SaaS 后台 · 健康应用 · 现代消费产品
styles.description: 新拟态的可用性改良版：保留柔和投影与圆角，但把对比度提到 4.5:1 以上，阴影更浅、层级更明确。温和而不牺牲可读性。
styles.primary: Improved contrast pastels: Soft Blue #87CEEB, Soft Pink #FFB6C1, Soft Green #90EE90, better hierarchy
styles.secondary: Better combinations, accessible secondary, supporting with improved contrast, modern accents
styles.bestFor: Modern enterprise apps, SaaS platforms, health/wellness, modern business tools, professional, hybrid
styles.avoid: Extreme minimalism, critical performance, systems without modern OS
styles.prompt: Design evolved neumorphism with improved contrast (measured contrast targets), modern aesthetics, subtle depth, accessibility focus. Use soft shadows (softer than flat but clearer than pure neumorphism), better color hierarchy, improved focus states, modern 200-300ms animations.
styles.checklist: ☐ Contrast measured against the chosen project target, ☐ Soft shadows modern, ☐ Border-radius 8-12px, ☐ Animations 200-300ms, ☐ Focus states visible, ☐ Color hierarchy clear

styles.name: Hero-Centric Design
styles.tag: 品牌落地页 · 产品发布（已弃用）
styles.description: 整屏交给一个主张：超大标题 + 主视觉 + 唯一 CTA，其余内容下沉。转化路径最短，但对文案与视觉质量要求极高。数据标注为已弃用，建议改用 Storytelling 或 Feature-Rich。
styles.primary: Brand primary color, white/light backgrounds for contrast, accent color for CTA
styles.secondary: Supporting colors for secondary CTAs, accent highlights, trust elements (testimonials, logos)
styles.bestFor: SaaS landing pages, product launches, service landing pages, B2B platforms, tech companies
styles.avoid: Complex navigation, multi-page experiences, data-heavy applications
styles.prompt: Design a hero-centric landing page. Use: full-width hero section, compelling headline (60-80 chars), high-contrast CTA button, product screenshot or video, value proposition above fold, gradient or image background, clear visual hierarchy.
styles.checklist: ☐ Hero section full viewport height, ☐ Headline visible above fold, ☐ CTA button high contrast, ☐ Background image optimized (WebP), ☐ Text readable on background, ☐ Mobile responsive layout

styles.name: Conversion-Optimized
styles.tag: 注册落地页 · 电商促销（已弃用）
styles.description: 一切为下一步动作让路：单一高对比 CTA、短表单、紧迫感提示与信任背书紧贴决策点。适合投放页，不适合内容型站点。
styles.primary: Primary brand color, high-contrast white/light backgrounds, warning/urgency colors for time-limited offers
styles.secondary: Secondary CTA color (muted), trust element colors (testimonial highlights), accent for key benefits
styles.bestFor: E-commerce product pages, free trial signups, lead generation, SaaS pricing pages, limited-time offers
styles.avoid: Complex feature explanations, multi-product showcases, technical documentation
styles.prompt: Design a conversion-optimized landing page. Use: single primary CTA, minimal distractions, trust badges, urgency elements (limited time), social proof (testimonials), clear value proposition, form above fold, progress indicators.
styles.checklist: ☐ Single primary CTA visible, ☐ Form fields minimal (3-5), ☐ Trust badges present, ☐ Social proof above fold, ☐ Mobile form optimized, ☐ Loading states implemented, ☐ A/B test ready

styles.name: Feature-Rich Showcase
styles.tag: B2B SaaS 官网 · 功能对比页（已弃用）
styles.description: 用卡片矩阵把功能、收益与截图铺开，靠图标色与留白分组。信息完整但容易冗长，需严格控制每组卡片数量与文案长度。
styles.primary: Primary brand, bright secondary colors for feature cards, contrasting accent for CTAs
styles.secondary: Supporting colors for: benefits (green), problems (red/orange), features (blue/purple), social proof (neutral)
styles.bestFor: Enterprise SaaS, software tools landing pages, platform services, complex product explanations, B2B products
styles.avoid: Simple product pages, early-stage startups with few features, entertainment landing pages
styles.prompt: Design a feature showcase landing page. Use: grid layout for features (3-4 columns), feature cards with icons, benefit-focused copy, alternating sections, comparison tables, interactive demos, problem-solution pairs.
styles.checklist: ☐ Feature grid responsive, ☐ Icons consistent style, ☐ Card hover effects smooth, ☐ Alternating sections contrast, ☐ Benefits clearly stated, ☐ Mobile stacks properly

styles.name: Minimal & Direct
styles.tag: 单页产品 · 个人作品（已弃用）
styles.description: 单列 680px 内容宽度、18px 正文、几乎无装饰，只保留一个 CTA。阅读体验最好，适合一句话就能说清的产品。
styles.primary: Monochromatic primary, white background, single accent color for CTA, black/dark grey text
styles.secondary: Minimal secondary colors, reserved for critical CTAs only, neutral supporting elements
styles.bestFor: Simple service landing pages, indie products, consulting services, micro SaaS, freelancer portfolios
styles.avoid: Feature-heavy products, complex explanations, multi-product showcases
styles.prompt: Design a minimal direct landing page. Use: single column layout, maximum white space, essential content only, one CTA, clean typography, no decorative elements, fast loading, direct messaging.

styles.primary: Primary brand, trust colors (blue), success/growth colors (green), neutral backgrounds

styles.description: 让用户在页面里直接操作真实产品片段，或以分步引导回放关键流程。说服力强，但加载成本与实现复杂度都高。

styles.name: Trust & Authority

styles.description: 深蓝与灰建立专业感，用资质徽章、合规声明、数据背书与客户 Logo 消除疑虑。视觉保守，但每一项装饰都服务于可信度。
styles.primary: Professional colors (blue/grey), trust colors, certification badge colors (gold/silver accents)

styles.name: Storytelling-Driven

styles.avoid: Technical/complex products (unless narrative-driven), traditional enterprise software

styles.checklist: ☐ Story flows naturally, ☐ Scroll reveals smooth, ☐ Sections timed well, ☐ Emotional hooks present, ☐ Mobile story readable, ☐ Skip option available

styles.name: Data-Dense Dashboard
styles.tag: 运营后台 · 监控中心 · 内部工具
styles.description: 在有限屏幕内塞入尽可能多的指标：12–14px 字号、36px 行高、8px 栅格、细分割线取代卡片阴影。效率优先，牺牲呼吸感。
styles.primary: Neutral primary (light grey/white #F5F5F5), data colors (blue/green/red), dark text #333333
styles.secondary: Chart colors: success (green #22C55E), warning (amber #F59E0B), alert (red #EF4444), neutral (grey)
styles.bestFor: Business intelligence dashboards, financial analytics, enterprise reporting, operational dashboards, data warehousing
styles.avoid: Marketing dashboards, consumer-facing analytics, simple reporting
styles.prompt: Design a data-dense dashboard. Use: multiple chart widgets, KPI cards row, data tables with sorting, minimal padding (8-12px), efficient grid layout, filter sidebar, dense but readable typography, maximum information density.
styles.checklist: ☐ Grid layout 12 columns, ☐ KPI cards responsive, ☐ Tables sortable, ☐ Filters functional, ☐ Loading states for data, ☐ Export functionality

styles.name: Heat Map & Heatmap Style
styles.tag: 行为分析 · 资源调度 · 排班
styles.description: 用冷—暖连续色阶编码数值密度，读者一眼看出热点与空白。需要清晰的色阶图例，并避免用红绿单独承载正负含义。
styles.primary: Gradient scale: Cool (blue #0080FF) to hot (red #FF0000), neutral middle (white/yellow)
styles.secondary: Support gradients: Light (cool blue) to dark (warm red), divergent for positive/negative data, monochromatic options
styles.bestFor: Geographical analysis, performance matrices, correlation analysis, user behavior heatmaps, temperature/intensity data
styles.avoid: Linear data representation, categorical comparisons (use bar charts), small datasets
styles.prompt: Design a heatmap visualization. Use: color gradient scale (cool to hot), cell-based grid, intensity legend, hover tooltips, geographic or matrix layout, divergent color scheme for +/- values, accessible color alternatives.
styles.checklist: ☐ Color scale clear, ☐ Legend visible, ☐ Tooltips informative, ☐ Colorblind alternatives, ☐ Zoom/pan for geo, ☐ Performance for large data

styles.name: Executive Dashboard
styles.tag: 经营驾驶舱 · 投后管理
styles.description: 第一屏只留 4–6 个核心 KPI 与趋势，细节藏进下钻页。数字大、说明少、结论前置，配合红绿状态与倒计时提醒。
styles.primary: Brand colors, professional palette (blue/grey/white), accent for KPIs, red for alerts/concerns
styles.secondary: KPI highlight colors: positive (green), negative (red), neutral (grey), trend arrow colors
styles.bestFor: C-suite dashboards, business summary reports, decision-maker dashboards, strategic planning views
styles.avoid: Detailed analyst dashboards, technical deep-dives, operational monitoring
styles.prompt: Design an executive dashboard. Use: large KPI cards (4-6 max), trend sparklines, high-level summary only, clean layout with white space, traffic light indicators (red/yellow/green), at-a-glance insights, minimal detail.
styles.checklist: ☐ KPIs 4-6 maximum, ☐ Trends visible, ☐ Status colors clear, ☐ One-page view, ☐ Mobile simplified, ☐ Print-friendly layout

styles.name: Real-Time Monitoring
styles.tag: 运维大屏 · IoT · 交易风控
styles.description: 数据流持续更新：状态灯、脉冲告警、流式曲线与最新值并列。深色底降低眩光，颜色语义必须严格区分正常/警告/严重。
styles.primary: Alert colors: critical (red #FF0000), warning (orange #FFA500), normal (green #22C55E), updating (blue animation)
styles.secondary: Status indicator colors, chart line colors varying by metric, streaming data highlight colors
styles.bestFor: System monitoring dashboards, DevOps dashboards, real-time analytics, stock market dashboards, live event tracking
styles.avoid: Historical analysis, long-term trend reports, archived data dashboards
styles.prompt: Design a real-time monitoring dashboard. Use: live status indicators (pulsing), streaming charts, alert notifications, connection status, auto-refresh indicators, critical alerts prominent, system health overview.
styles.checklist: ☐ Live updates working, ☐ Alert sounds optional, ☐ Connection status shown, ☐ Auto-refresh indicated, ☐ Critical alerts prominent, ☐ Offline fallback

styles.name: Drill-Down Analytics
styles.tag: BI 平台 · 财务分析 · 用户增长
styles.description: 用面包屑、层级缩进与上下文条记录「我在哪一层」，点击图表即进入明细。关键是保持筛选条件可见、可回退。
styles.primary: Primary brand, breadcrumb colors, drill-level indicator colors, hierarchy depth colors
styles.secondary: Drill-down path indicator colors, level-specific colors, highlight colors for selected level, transition colors
styles.bestFor: Sales analytics, product analytics, funnel analysis, multi-dimensional data exploration, business intelligence
styles.avoid: Simple linear data, single-metric dashboards, streaming real-time dashboards
styles.prompt: Design a drill-down analytics dashboard. Use: breadcrumb navigation, expandable sections, summary-to-detail flow, back button prominent, level indicators, context preservation, hierarchical data display.
styles.checklist: ☐ Breadcrumbs clear, ☐ Back navigation easy, ☐ Expand animation smooth, ☐ Context preserved, ☐ Mobile drill works, ☐ Deep links supported

styles.name: Comparative Analysis Dashboard
styles.tag: 竞品分析 · A/B 实验 · 期间对比
styles.description: 同屏并列两组数据：主序列蓝、对照橙/紫，差值用箭头与徽章标注。避免双 Y 轴误导，差异要能被颜色和方向同时读出。
styles.primary: Comparison colors: primary (blue), comparison (orange/purple), delta indicator (green/red)
styles.secondary: Winning metric color (green), losing metric color (red), neutral comparison (grey), benchmark colors
styles.bestFor: Period-over-period reporting, A/B test dashboards, market comparison, competitive analysis, regional performance
styles.avoid: Single metric dashboards, future projections (use forecasting), real-time only (no historical)
styles.prompt: Design a comparison dashboard. Use: side-by-side metrics, period selectors (vs last month), delta indicators (+/-), benchmark lines, A/B comparison tables, winning/losing highlights, percentage change badges.
styles.checklist: ☐ Period selector works, ☐ Deltas calculated, ☐ Colors meaningful, ☐ Benchmarks shown, ☐ Mobile stacks properly, ☐ Export comparison

styles.name: Predictive Analytics
styles.tag: 需求预测 · 风险管理 · 增长建模
styles.description: 历史实线 + 预测虚线 + 置信区间带，异常点高亮。必须标注模型版本与不确定性，否则容易被误读为确定结论。
styles.primary: Forecast line color (distinct from actual), confidence interval shading, anomaly highlight (red alert), trend colors
styles.secondary: High confidence (dark color), low confidence (light color), anomaly colors (red/orange), normal trend (green/blue)
styles.bestFor: Forecasting dashboards, anomaly detection systems, trend prediction dashboards, AI-powered analytics, budget planning
styles.avoid: Historical-only dashboards, simple reporting, real-time operational dashboards
styles.prompt: Design a predictive analytics dashboard. Use: forecast lines (dashed), confidence intervals (shaded bands), trend projections, anomaly highlights, scenario toggles, AI insight cards, probability indicators.
styles.checklist: ☐ Forecast line distinct, ☐ Confidence bands visible, ☐ Anomalies highlighted, ☐ Scenarios switchable, ☐ Predictions dated, ☐ Accuracy shown

styles.name: User Behavior Analytics
styles.tag: 增长分析 · 漏斗优化 · 留存
styles.description: 以漏斗、路径图与同期群表格还原用户旅程：每级流失率、分支权重、留存曲线。强化「从哪掉、为什么掉」而非堆砌指标。
styles.primary: Funnel stage colors: high engagement (green), drop-off (red), conversion (blue), user flow arrows (grey)
styles.secondary: Stage completion colors (success), abandonment colors (warning), engagement levels (gradient), cohort colors
styles.bestFor: Conversion funnel analysis, user journey tracking, engagement analytics, cohort analysis, retention tracking
styles.avoid: Real-time operational metrics, technical system monitoring, financial transactions
styles.prompt: Design a user behavior analytics dashboard. Use: funnel visualization, user flow diagrams (Sankey), conversion metrics, engagement heatmaps, cohort tables, retention curves, session replay indicators.
styles.checklist: ☐ Funnel stages clear, ☐ Flow diagram readable, ☐ Conversions calculated, ☐ Cohorts comparable, ☐ Retention trends visible, ☐ Privacy compliant

styles.name: Financial Dashboard
styles.tag: 财务系统 · 交易终端 · 预算管理
styles.description: 金额对齐、千分位、正负色与等宽数字是底线；同比/环比与预算差异并列呈现。红色需按财务语义使用，避免与品牌红冲突。
styles.primary: Financial colors: profit (green #22C55E), loss (red #EF4444), neutral (grey), trust (dark blue #003366)
styles.secondary: Revenue highlight (green), expenses (red), budget variance (orange/red), balance (grey), accuracy (blue)
styles.bestFor: Financial reporting, accounting dashboards, portfolio tracking, budget monitoring, banking analytics
styles.avoid: Simple business dashboards, entertainment/social metrics, non-financial data

styles.checklist: ☐ Currency formatted, ☐ Decimals consistent, ☐ P&L clear, ☐ Budget variance shown, ☐ Audit trail complete, ☐ Export to Excel

styles.name: Sales Intelligence Dashboard
styles.tag: CRM · 销售管理 · 业绩复盘
styles.description: 按阶段呈现管道金额与赢单率，配合排行榜、配额进度与预测准确度。个人与团队视图要能一键切换。
styles.primary: Sales colors: won (green), lost (red), in-progress (blue), blocked (orange), quota met (gold), quota missed (grey)
styles.secondary: Pipeline stage colors, rep performance colors, quota achievement colors, forecast accuracy colors
styles.bestFor: CRM dashboards, sales management, opportunity tracking, performance management, quota planning
styles.avoid: Marketing analytics, customer support metrics, HR dashboards
styles.prompt: Design a sales intelligence dashboard. Use: pipeline funnel, deal cards (kanban), quota gauges, leaderboard table, territory map, win/loss ratios, forecast accuracy, activity timeline.
styles.checklist: ☐ Pipeline stages shown, ☐ Deals draggable, ☐ Quotas visualized, ☐ Rankings updated, ☐ Territory clickable, ☐ CRM integration

styles.name: Neubrutalism

styles.primary: #FFEB3B (Yellow), #FF5252 (Red), #2196F3 (Blue), #000000 (Black borders)

styles.primary: Neutral base (#FFFFFF, #F5F5F5, #E0E0E0) + brand accent for elevated elements

styles.primary: #000000 (Black), #FFFFFF (White), single vibrant accent only
styles.secondary: Minimal - single accent color, no secondary colors, extreme restraint

styles.avoid: E-commerce catalogs, dashboards, forms, data-heavy, elderly users, complex apps

styles.primary: Flexible - high contrast recommended, bold colors for emphasis, animation-friendly palette
